machine_start_gcode.label: Start G-code
machine_start_gcode.default_value:
G28 ;Home
G1 Z15.0 F6000 ;Move the platform down 15mm
;Prime the extruder
G92 E0
G1 F200 E3
G92 E0

machine_end_gcode.label: End G-code
machine_end_gcode.default_value:
M104 S0
M140 S0
;Retract the filament
G92 E1
G1 E-1 F300
G28 X0 Y0
M84

extruders_enabled_count.label: Number of Extruders that are enabled

reinforcement_start_layer.label: Reinforcement start layer
reinforcement_start_layer.value: max(1, round((reinforcement_start_height) / layer_height) + 1) if layer_height != 0 else 0

reinforcement_layer_count.label: Reinforcement layer count
reinforcement_layer_count.value: max(1, round((reinforcement_height) / layer_height) + 1) if layer_height != 0 else 0

fiber_infill_pattern_classic.label: Classic Infill Pattern
fiber_infill_pattern_classic.value: [0 if fiber_infill_pattern == 'lines'  else (1 if fiber_infill_pattern == 'grid' else 2)]

fiber_infill_pattern_cylindrical.label: Cylindrical Infill Pattern
fiber_infill_pattern_cylindrical.value: [0 if fiber_infill_pattern == 'lines'  else (1 if fiber_infill_pattern == 'grid' else 2)]

fiber_line_distance_classic.label: Classic Line Distance
fiber_line_distance_classic.value: 0 if fiber_density == 0 else (fiber_infill_line_width * 100) / fiber_density_classic * (2 if infill_pattern == 'grid' else (3 if infill_pattern == 'triangles' or infill_pattern == 'trihexagon' or infill_pattern == 'cubic' or infill_pattern == 'cubicsubdiv' else (2 if infill_pattern == 'tetrahedral' or infill_pattern == 'quarter_cubic' else (1 if infill_pattern == 'cross' or infill_pattern == 'cross_3d' else 1))))

fiber_line_distance_cylindrical.label: Cylindrical Line Distance
fiber_line_distance_cylindrical.value: [0 if fiber_density == 0 else (fiber_infill_line_width * 100) / fiber_density_cylindrical * (2 if infill_pattern == 'grid' else (3 if infill_pattern == 'triangles' or infill_pattern == 'trihexagon' or infill_pattern == 'cubic' or infill_pattern == 'cubicsubdiv' else (2 if infill_pattern == 'tetrahedral' or infill_pattern == 'quarter_cubic' else (1 if infill_pattern == 'cross' or infill_pattern == 'cross_3d' else 1))))]

wall_line_count.label: Wall Line Count
wall_line_count.value: 1 if magic_spiralize else max(1, round((wall_thickness - wall_line_width_0) / wall_line_width_x) + 1) if wall_thickness != 0 else 0

wall_0_inset.label: Outer Wall Inset
wall_0_inset.value: (machine_nozzle_size - wall_line_width_0) / 2 if (wall_line_width_0 < machine_nozzle_size and not outer_inset_first) else 0

infill_line_distance.label: Infill Line Distance
infill_line_distance.value: 0 if infill_sparse_density == 0 else (infill_line_width * 100) / infill_sparse_density * (2 if infill_pattern == 'grid' else (3 if infill_pattern == 'triangles' or infill_pattern == 'trihexagon' or infill_pattern == 'cubic' or infill_pattern == 'cubicsubdiv' else (2 if infill_pattern == 'tetrahedral' or infill_pattern == 'quarter_cubic' else (1 if infill_pattern == 'cross' or infill_pattern == 'cross_3d' else 1))))

zig_zaggify_infill.label: Connect Infill Lines
zig_zaggify_infill.enabled: infill_pattern == 'lines' or infill_pattern == 'grid' or infill_pattern == 'triangles' or infill_pattern == 'trihexagon' or infill_pattern == 'cubic' or infill_pattern == 'tetrahedral' or infill_pattern == 'quarter_cubic' or infill_pattern == 'cross' or infill_pattern == 'cross_3d' or infill_pattern == 'gyroid'

connect_infill_polygons.label: Connect Infill Polygons
connect_infill_polygons.value: (infill_pattern == 'cross' or infill_pattern == 'cross_3d' or infill_multiplier % 2 == 0) and infill_wall_line_count > 0
connect_infill_polygons.enabled: infill_pattern == 'cross' or infill_pattern == 'cross_3d' or infill_pattern == 'concentric' or infill_multiplier % 2 == 0 or infill_wall_line_count > 1

infill_offset_x.label: Infill X Offset
infill_offset_x.enabled: infill_pattern == 'grid' or infill_pattern == 'lines' or infill_pattern == 'triangles' or infill_pattern == 'cubic' or infill_pattern == 'tetrahedral' or infill_pattern == 'quarter_cubic' or infill_pattern == 'zigzag'

infill_offset_y.label: Infill Y Offset
infill_offset_y.enabled: infill_pattern == 'grid' or infill_pattern == 'lines' or infill_pattern == 'triangles' or infill_pattern == 'cubic' or infill_pattern == 'tetrahedral' or infill_pattern == 'quarter_cubic' or infill_pattern == 'zigzag'

infill_multiplier.label: Infill Line Multiplier
infill_multiplier.enabled: infill_sparse_density > 0 and not spaghetti_infill_enabled and infill_pattern != 'zigzag'

infill_overlap_mm.label: Infill Overlap
infill_overlap_mm.value: 0.5 * (infill_line_width + (wall_line_width_x if wall_line_count > 1 else wall_line_width_0)) * infill_overlap / 100 if infill_sparse_density < 95 and infill_pattern != 'concentric' else 0

skin_overlap_mm.label: Skin Overlap
skin_overlap_mm.value: 0.5 * (skin_line_width + (wall_line_width_x if wall_line_count > 1 else wall_line_width_0)) * skin_overlap / 100 if top_bottom_pattern != 'concentric' else 0

infill_sparse_thickness.label: Infill Layer Thickness
infill_sparse_thickness.maximum_value: resolveOrValue('layer_height') * (1.45 if spaghetti_infill_enabled else 8) if infill_line_distance > 0 else 999999

gradual_infill_steps.label: Gradual Infill Steps
gradual_infill_steps.maximum_value: 0 if spaghetti_infill_enabled else (999999 if infill_line_distance == 0 else (20 - math.log(infill_line_distance) / math.log(2)))
gradual_infill_steps.maximum_value_warning: 1 if (infill_pattern == 'cross' or infill_pattern == 'cross_3d' or support_pattern == 'concentric') else 5
gradual_infill_steps.enabled: infill_sparse_density > 0 and infill_pattern != 'cubicsubdiv' and not spaghetti_infill_enabled

skirt_brim_material_flow.label: Skirt/Brim Flow
skirt_brim_material_flow.enabled: resolveOrValue('adhesion_type') == 'skirt' or resolveOrValue('adhesion_type') == 'brim' or resolveOrValue('draft_shield_enabled') or resolveOrValue('ooze_shield_enabled')

retraction_combing_max_distance.label: Max Comb Distance With No Retract

start_layers_at_same_position.label: Start Layers with the Same Part

retraction_hop_only_when_collides.label: Z Hop Only Over Printed Parts

support_wall_count.label: Support Wall Line Count
support_wall_count.value: 1 if (support_pattern == 'grid' or support_pattern == 'triangles' or support_pattern == 'concentric') else 0

support_infill_rate.label: Support Density
support_infill_rate.value: 15 if support_enable else 0 if support_tree_enable else 15

support_line_distance.label: Support Line Distance
support_line_distance.value: 0 if support_infill_rate == 0 else (support_line_width * 100) / support_infill_rate * (2 if support_pattern == 'grid' else (3 if support_pattern == 'triangles' else 1))

support_bottom_distance_cylindrical.label: Cylindrical Support Bottom Distance
support_bottom_distance_cylindrical.value: extruderValue(support_bottom_extruder_nr if support_bottom_enable else support_infill_extruder_nr, 'support_z_distance_cylindrical') if support_type == 'everywhere' else 0

support_bottom_distance.label: Classic Support Bottom Distance
support_bottom_distance.value: extruderValue(support_bottom_extruder_nr if support_bottom_enable else support_infill_extruder_nr, 'support_z_distance') if support_type == 'everywhere' else 0

gradual_support_infill_steps.label: Gradual Support Infill Steps
gradual_support_infill_steps.maximum_value_warning: 1 if (support_pattern == 'cross' or support_pattern == 'lines' or support_pattern == 'zigzag' or support_pattern == 'concentric') else 5

gradual_support_infill_step_height.label: Gradual Support Infill Step Height
gradual_support_infill_step_height.enabled: (support_enable or support_tree_enable) and support_infill_rate > 0 and gradual_support_infill_steps > 0

support_roof_line_distance.label: Support Roof Line Distance
support_roof_line_distance.value: 0 if support_roof_density == 0 else (support_roof_line_width * 100) / support_roof_density * (2 if support_roof_pattern == 'grid' else (3 if support_roof_pattern == 'triangles' else 1))

support_bottom_line_distance.label: Support Floor Line Distance
support_bottom_line_distance.value: 0 if support_bottom_density == 0 else (support_bottom_line_width * 100) / support_bottom_density * (2 if support_bottom_pattern == 'grid' else (3 if support_bottom_pattern == 'triangles' else 1))

raft_total_height.label: Total Raft Height
raft_total_height.value: 10 * cylindrical_raft_thickness - (resolveOrValue('raft_base_thickness')  + resolveOrValue('raft_surface_thickness') + resolveOrValue('raft_interface_thickness')) if (cylindrical_mode_base_diameter < cylindrical_raft_diameter) else (resolveOrValue('raft_base_thickness')  + resolveOrValue('raft_surface_thickness') + resolveOrValue('raft_interface_thickness'))

cylindrical_raft_enabled.label: Print cylindrical raft
cylindrical_raft_enabled.value: machine_five_axis and not (resolveOrValue('printing_mode') == 'classic' and machine_hybrid) and resolveOrValue('printing_mode') in ['discrete', 'cylindrical_full', 'spherical_full','conical_full']

prime_tower_min_volume.label: Prime Tower Minimum Volume
prime_tower_min_volume.maximum_value_warning: ((resolveOrValue('prime_tower_size') * 0.5) ** 2 * 3.14159 * resolveOrValue('layer_height') if prime_tower_circular else resolveOrValue('prime_tower_size') ** 2 * resolveOrValue('layer_height')) - sum(extruderValues('prime_tower_min_volume')) + prime_tower_min_volume

prime_tower_position_x.label: Prime Tower X Position
prime_tower_position_x.value: machine_width - max(extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'brim_width') * extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'initial_layer_line_width_factor') / 100 if adhesion_type == 'brim' else (extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'raft_margin') if adhesion_type == 'raft' else (extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'skirt_gap') if adhesion_type == 'skirt' else 0)), max(extruderValues('travel_avoid_distance'))) - max(extruderValues('support_offset')) - sum(extruderValues('skirt_brim_line_width')) * extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'initial_layer_line_width_factor') / 100 - (resolveOrValue('draft_shield_dist') if resolveOrValue('draft_shield_enabled') else 0) - 1
prime_tower_position_x.minimum_value: resolveOrValue('prime_tower_size') - machine_width / 2 if machine_center_is_zero else resolveOrValue('prime_tower_size')

prime_tower_position_y.label: Prime Tower Y Position
prime_tower_position_y.value: machine_depth - prime_tower_size - max(extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'brim_width') * extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'initial_layer_line_width_factor') / 100 if adhesion_type == 'brim' else (extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'raft_margin') if adhesion_type == 'raft' else (extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'skirt_gap') if adhesion_type == 'skirt' else 0)), max(extruderValues('travel_avoid_distance'))) - max(extruderValues('support_offset')) - sum(extruderValues('skirt_brim_line_width')) * extruderValue(adhesion_extruder_nr, 'initial_layer_line_width_factor') / 100 - (resolveOrValue('draft_shield_dist') if resolveOrValue('draft_shield_enabled') else 0) - 1
prime_tower_position_y.maximum_value: machine_depth / 2 - resolveOrValue('prime_tower_size') if machine_center_is_zero else machine_depth - resolveOrValue('prime_tower_size')

prime_tower_wipe_enabled.label: Wipe Inactive Nozzle on Prime Tower

alternate_carve_order.label: Alternate Mesh Removal
alternate_carve_order.enabled: carve_multiple_volumes and all(p != 'surface' for p in extruderValues('magic_mesh_surface_mode'))

cross_support_density_image.label: Cross Fill Density Image for Support

flow_rate_max_extrusion_offset.label: Flow rate compensation max extrusion offset
